title: Sub-bottom profiling shows the layers under the object

tellings.quote: sub-bottom profiling have we done. Mhm.

plain: Around 2025, a team looked beneath a strange round object on the floor of the Baltic Sea using sub-bottom profiling, a kind of sonar that sees into the layers under the seabed. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, who found the object, mentions it only briefly and confirms that the profiling was done. It ties to his claim that new data show the object sits apart from the seabed under it.
